body.name: matter
body.description: One piece of client work under one engagement letter: a legal matter, audit, tax job or consulting project. Holds scope, billing model, team and dates. Created when a deal is won, and has its own delivery pipeline.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Client name and a neutral work description. No confidential detail in the name.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.matter}.

body.name: conflict_check
body.description: The record of one conflict-of-interest check run before we advised or proposed: who was checked, the result and who cleared it. Kept as an audit trail, separate from the deal.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Client or prospect name and the date of the check.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.conflict_check}.
